title: WPP Greater China announces leadership transition for next phase of growth
summary: WPP Greater China enters its next phase with a more integrated business, continued investment in technology and a strong leadership team Tina Chen and Kevin Zhu will provide leadership continuity through the transition, with new leadership to be announced
body_markdown:
[以中文显示新闻稿 >](https://www.wpp.com/zh-CN/news/wpp-greater-china-announces-leadership-transition-for-next-phase-of-growth)


WPP today announced the next phase of leadership for its Greater China business, as the company continues to strengthen its integrated client offer, invest in technology and position the business for future growth in one of the world’s most important markets.


As part of this transition, Chris Reitermann, CEO of WPP Greater China, will leave WPP on 31 December 2026 after more than 30 years with Ogilvy and WPP. WPP will announce the next phase of leadership for Greater China in due course.


Tina Chen, CEO of WPP Media, and Kevin Zhu, CEO of WPP Creative, will work closely together through the transition, ensuring leadership continuity and uninterrupted service for clients. Supported by WPP’s broader leadership team in Greater China, they will continue to advance WPP’s integrated offer, technology capabilities and growth agenda in the market.


WPP Greater China enters this next phase with a more connected business and significant investment behind its strategy. WPP Open | China, the pioneering agentic marketing platform was designed for China’s digital, media and commerce environment, while the WPP Operations and Delivery Hub in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, furthered its service portfolio in content, social, production, performance and commerce operations to meet the evolving needs of brands. Together with closer integration across WPP’s agencies, these investments are strengthening WPP’s ability to connect creativity, media, data, technology and production to help clients grow in China.


Chris has spent more than 30 years with Ogilvy and WPP, holding senior local, regional and global leadership positions, including CEO of Ogilvy Asia Pacific and a member of Ogilvy’s global executive leadership team. Since becoming CEO of WPP Greater China in 2024, he has helped drive greater integration across the business, accelerate technology adoption and strengthen the platform for WPP’s next phase of growth in the market.


**Cindy Rose, CEO of WPP, said** : “Greater China is an important market for WPP and our clients, and we have a strong business and leadership team in place to take it forward. We have made significant progress bringing our capabilities closer together and investing in the technology and talent our clients need to grow, including WPP Open | China.


“Tina and Kevin will ensure continuity and focus for our people and clients through the transition as we prepare for the next phase of leadership. Chris has made an exceptional contribution to WPP over three decades, and I want to thank him for his leadership and the important role he has played in building the platform we have today.”


**Chris Reitermann said** : “It has been a privilege to spend more than 30 years with Ogilvy and WPP, working alongside extraordinary colleagues and clients in Greater China, across Asia Pacific and around the world.


“I’m proud of the progress we have made in Greater China, bringing our people and capabilities closer together and strengthening the technology and operational platform for the future. WPP has an exceptional team in Greater China, and I am confident in the opportunity ahead for the business, our clients and our people. I am deeply grateful to everyone who has been part of this journey.”
